items.title: salaami layeeno'n  ne kya kya
items.body:
salaami layeeno'n ne kya kya jafa ki
na sheh ki hui aal mushkilkusha ki

<<DIVIDER>>

na chooti dame marg tak fatima se
itaa'at Ali ki ibaadat khuda ki

<<DIVIDER>>

rahe haath chakki se majrooh dono
ye haalat thi maqdoomae aasia ki

<<DIVIDER>>

ye kehti thi binte Ali waqte ghaarat
kuch ae shimr qeemat nahi is rida ki

<<DIVIDER>>

mere sar pa lillah rehne de isko
ke ye kohna chaadar hai qairunnisa ki

<<DIVIDER>>

tamaashaayi kehte the koofe me has kar
ye sar nange zainab hai qudrat khuda ki

<<DIVIDER>>

utha raat ko jiski maa ka janaza
wo din ko mehtaaj hai ek rida ki

<<DIVIDER>>

na baandho mere haath kehti thi zainab
layeeno'n mai beti hoo'n mushkilkusha ki
